G. 3000-11-37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. SPECIAL POLICE
REGISTRY
Special Branch D. 7869
26 / 38
REPORT
Date Jan. 25, 1938
Subject Objectionable Article appearing in the "Eastern Daily News."
Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross

Acting on instructions of D. C. (Special Branch) on
the attached translation of an article published by the
"Eastern Daily News" (東方日報), a daily mosquito paper, on
January 21, Mr. Dung Ying-sien (鄧蔭先), publisher and
editor of the paper in question, was interviewed at Police
Headquarters at 2.30 p.m. January 25 when a warning was
given him by the P. A. to D. C. (Special Branch) against
publishing reports of Japanese soldiers molesting Chinese
women.

In reply, Mr. Dung promised to refrain from publishing
articles of this nature in future, but he pointed out that
proofs of all reading matters to be published in his paper
are submitted to the Shanghai Press Censorship Bureau, in
the Hardoon Building, Nanking Road, for censorship.

His statement was verified. It is believed that the
Japanese censors had probably overlooked the objectionable
article in question whilst censoring the proof.

D. C. (Special Branch)
（签名）
C: D. I.

（左侧批注：Inquiries made
by S. Kowalski
O.B.
25/1
（签名））

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
25 JAN. 1938
SPECIAL BRANCH）

档案号：特别警察
登记处
特务科 D. 7869
26 / 38
报告
日期：1938年1月25日
事由：《东方日报》刊登不当文章。
呈报人及转交人：C.D.I. Ross

根据特务科副主管（D. C. (Special Branch)）的指示，就附译的1月21日由一份名为“蚊子小报”的日报《东方日报》（東方日報）所刊登的一篇文章，该报出版人兼编辑邓荫先（鄧蔭先）先生于1月25日下午2时30分在警察总局接受问询。当时，特务科副主管的警务助理（P. A. to D. C. (Special Branch)）向他发出警告，禁止其刊登有关日本士兵骚扰中国妇女的报道。

作为回应，邓先生承诺今后不再刊登此类性质的文章，但他指出，其报纸拟刊登的所有读物校样均提交至南京路哈同大楼（Hardoon Building）的上海新闻检查局进行检查。

经核实，其陈述属实。据信，日本检查员在审查校样时，可能疏忽漏看了这篇有争议的文章。

特务科副主管（D. C. (Special Branch)）
（签名）
C: D. I.

（左侧批注：S. Kowalski 进行查询
O.B.
1月25日
（签名））

（印章：上海公共租界
1938年1月25日
特务科）

Eastern Daily News (東方日報), a mosquito newspaper, dated
January 21 :-

ALLEGATIONS OF MOLESTATION OF WOMEN

It is not buildings but women who have
suffered the most within the zone of hostilities during
the present Sino-Japanese conflict. It is said that
all females above the age of 13 and below 60, irrespective
of appearance, have been molested by XX soldiers. In the
case of old women, they would be assaulted after their
faces had been covered with a cloth. If they offered
the slightest resistance, they would be killed with
bayonet. In many cases females were subjected to
assaults by more than ten persons. Some were put to
death despite their earnest pleadings.

（批：Monrdo）
（批：mB）
（批：22 JAN. 1938）
（批：S.S.）
（批：DA）
（批：24/1）

《东方日报》（東方日報），一份蚊子小报，日期为1月21日：-

关于骚扰妇女的指控

在当前中日冲突的战区内，遭受苦难最深的并非建筑物，而是妇女。据说，所有年龄在13岁以上、60岁以下的女性，无论外貌如何，均遭到XX士兵的骚扰。对于老年妇女，施暴者会用布蒙住她们的脸后实施侵犯。若她们稍有反抗，便会遭刺刀杀害。在许多案例中，女性遭到十余人轮奸。尽管她们苦苦哀求，仍有一些人被杀害。

（批注：Monrdo）
（批注：mB）
（批注：1938年1月22日）
（批注：S.S.）
（批注：DA）
（批注：1月24日）

REPORT
Date April 12 1937.7

Subject (in full)...Article entitled "Superstition" appearing in the "Eastern
Daily News" of April 6, 1937.

Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by....C. D. I. Ross

Mr. Dung Ying Sien(鄧先), Editor of the "Eastern
Daily News"(東方日報), a mosquito newspaper, was interviewed
at Headquarters on April 9 and warned against publishing
allegations of this nature.

Mr. Dung in expressing his regret stated that he is
unable to prove the allegation, and promised that apart from
publishing a correction (translation attached), he will
exercise greater care in future.

C. D. I.

pages.en:
Eastern Daily News (東方日報) publishes the following article
written by Sien Yui (細雨) :- 6.4.37.

SUPERSTITION

It is said to be a superstitious act to worship
idols. This is true, but the Christians who pray or even
kneel down before each meal are also superstitious. The
Christians say that those who do not believe in Jesus are
in league with the Devil and will go to Hell, while those
who believe in Him will rise to Heaven. This is nothing
but cheating. However, many women believe such things.
Once a certain priest, seeing that women were
easily cheated, told some of them to discard their ornaments
such as gold or silver rings, bracelets etc., saying that
God would punish those who wore them. All the women
willingly handed over their ornaments to the priest who
took them away. These women would not give half a cent
to a beggar, and yet they were so generous on that occasion.
This shows the influence of Jesus Christ.

(Editor's note: It seems that this is the first
time a priest is said to have defrauded others of property.
This article is published for the reason that the writer
has not deliberately resorted to reckless abuse.)

（印：OFFICE OF CENSORSHIP CHANGSHA 7 APR. 1937）
pages.zh:
《东方日报》（東方日報）刊登了由细雨（細雨）撰写的以下文章：- 1937年4月6日。

迷信

据说崇拜偶像是一种迷信行为。此言不虚，但那些在每餐前祈祷甚至下跪的基督徒也是迷信的。基督徒声称，不信耶稣的人是与魔鬼结盟并将下地狱，而信他的人则将升天堂。这不过是欺骗而已。然而，许多妇女相信此类说法。曾有一位神父，见妇女易受欺骗，便让其中一些人丢弃金戒指、银手镯等饰物，声称上帝会惩罚佩戴这些饰物的人。所有妇女都自愿将饰物交给神父，由其拿走。这些妇女连半分钱都不愿施舍给乞丐，但在那次事件中却如此慷慨。这显示了耶稣基督的影响力。

（编者按：似乎这是首次有人称神父诈骗他人财物。刊登此文的原因在于作者并非故意进行鲁莽的谩骂。）

（印章：长沙新闻检查处办公室 1937年4月7日）
